_comment: Baseline for scripts/freebuff_preflight.py. Tool counts drift when a server updates; a mismatch is reported as WARN (not FAIL), while a server that cannot complete the MCP handshake under Freebuff's child environment is a FAIL. Index age limits are hours; exceeding one is a WARN that --fix can clear.
